rss: UK diesel price hits all-time high, RAC says
title: Soda and Juice Prices Bubble Up
story: The fizz and juice trucks have to use more gas to get to stores. This makes soda and juice a bit more pricey. What do you think happens next?
storyBig: With rising transportation costs due to increased fuel prices, the cost of delivering FIZZ and JUCE products to retailers has escalated. How might this affect consumer pricing and company profit margins?
think: How does the cost of gas affect what we buy?
bull: FIZZ and JUCE might become more valuable as people stock up.
bear: Higher prices might make customers buy less soda and juice.

rss: Healey to promise 'new age of industrialisation' for UK in conference speech
title: Toy Factory Boom in Brickland!
story: Brickland wants to make more toy factories to build cool things like BLOK toys and RCCR cars. What will happen if more toys are made?
storyBig: Brickland is investing in new manufacturing facilities, aiming to increase production of BLOK and RCCR products. This surge in local industrial activity can boost employment and regional economic growth.
think: What could more toy factories mean for jobs?
bull: More toy factories mean more jobs and lots of toys!
bear: Making new factories might take a long time and be costly.
